import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class P851C
{
	static double eps = 1e-9;
	public static void main(String[] args)
	{
		Scanner scan = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = scan.nextInt();
		if (n > 11)
		{
			System.out.println(0);
			return;
		}
		int[][] arr = new int[n][5];
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
			{
				arr[i][j] = scan.nextInt();
			}
		}
		ArrayList<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
		{
			boolean good = true;
			for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
			{
				if (j == i)
					continue;
				for (int k = j+1; k < n; k++)
				{
					if (k == i)
						continue;
					int[] v1 = new int[5];
					int[] v2 = new int[5];
					for (int l = 0; l < 5; l++)
					{
						v1[l] = arr[i][l] - arr[j][l];
						v2[l] = arr[i][l] - arr[k][l];
					}
					double angle = Math.acos((double)v1[0]*v2[0] + v1[1]*v2[1] + v1[2]*v2[2] + v1[3]*v2[3] + v1[4]*v2[4])/((double)v1[0]*v1[0] + v1[1]*v1[1] + v1[2]*v1[2] + v1[3]*v1[3] + v1[4]*v1[4])/(double)v2[0]*v2[0] + v2[1]*v2[1] + v2[2]*v2[2] + v2[3]*v2[3] + v2[4]*v2[4]);
					if (angle < Math.PI/2-eps)
					{
						good = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (good)
				list.add(i+1);
		}
		System.out.println(list.size());
		for (int i : list)
			System.out.println(i);
	}
}
